name: feishu-agent-bridge
description: Bridge local agents and Codex CLI sessions with Feishu notifications and group commands.

interface.shortDescription: Send Agent results to Feishu and continue Codex work from Feishu group commands.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP bridge for Feishu self-built app bots. It sends task-result cards, receives group @ commands over Feishu long connection, stores a durable local command queue, and can hand normal commands to Codex CLI resume while keeping the core bridge usable by any MCP client.
defaultPrompt: Send the current task result to Feishu.
Start listening for Feishu group commands.
List available Codex sessions from Feishu.
